description: Composite figure whose two panels are of different kinds. (a) Left: a colour optical micrograph (green/yellow tint, etched metal surface) of a polycrystalline region showing grains delimited by dark, irregular boundaries plus a few small dark rounded inclusions/pores; a Cartesian frame with arrowheads labelled X and Y and origin O is superimposed on the surface, and a small dashed rectangle drawn immediately to the right of O marks the measurement region; two short green horizontal lines lie at the left and right edges of the micrograph (a scale bar whose numeric value is not readable). (b) Right: a schematic of the measurement grid — the annotation 'Measured point' with an arrow points to one grid node; X and Y axes are drawn with arrowheads; grid nodes are open circles at X=0, X=1, X=2 and Y=0, Y=1, Y=2 (a 3×3 visible arrangement), and '#' symbols are printed beside some nodes; 'Unit:μm' is printed at bottom right. Together the panels argue that the micro-region enclosed by the dashed rectangle in (a) is sampled on the micrometre-spaced grid defined in (b). The caption states (a) is the measurement region before CMP treatment; the citing text states a 1 μm interval and 20 and 3 points in X and Y, which disagrees with the 3×3 nodes visible in (b).
measured_quantities: measurement interval in X and Y (μm)
number of measurement points in X and Y directions (count)
grid node coordinates X=0,1,2 and Y=0,1,2 (μm)

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a colour optical micrograph of a polycrystalline metal surface, with grains outlined by dark boundaries and a few dark rounded inclusions; no scale-bar value is printed.
A Cartesian coordinate frame with arrows labelled X and Y and origin O is superimposed on the micrograph in (a), and a dashed rectangle adjacent to O indicates the measurement region.
Panel (b) is a schematic grid with an annotation 'Measured point' whose arrow indicates a single node, and it prints 'Unit:μm' at the bottom right.
The grid in (b) shows open-circle nodes arranged in 3 columns (X=0, X=1, X=2) and 3 rows (Y=0, Y=1, Y=2), with X and Y axes drawn as arrows extending beyond the outermost nodes.
In (b) '#' symbols are printed adjacent to several grid-node positions rather than being plotted as separate nodes.
The caption states the figure is a microscopic image of the measurement region before CMP treatment.
The citing text states that the rectangular area in the figure is the measurement region and that the measurement was performed with an interval distance of 1 μm.

The citing text states the total measurement points are 20 and 3 in X and Y directions respectively (i.e. 20 along X, 3 along Y); this disagrees with the 3 columns × 3 rows of nodes visible in panel (b).
The citing text states the measurement results themselves are presented in Fig. 12, so this figure only defines the region and sampling grid, not the measured values.

subfigures.description: Colour optical micrograph of an etched polycrystalline surface (green/yellow tint) with dark grain boundaries and a few dark inclusions/pores. Superimposed X (right) and Y (up) arrows with origin O, and a dashed rectangle next to O marking the measurement region. Two short green horizontal lines at the left and right edges may be a scale bar but carry no readable value.

Schematic of the measurement grid: 'Measured point' label with an arrow to one node, X and Y axes with arrowheads, open-circle nodes at X=0,1,2 and Y=0,1,2, '#' symbols beside some nodes, and 'Unit:μm' at bottom right.
